title: Rush Live & Louder Will Show CPL 2026 Across the Caribbean
description: Rush Live & Louder will carry the men’s and women’s CPL in 2026 through major Caribbean cable and television networks from 7 August.
dek: The dedicated cricket channel gives Caribbean viewers a confirmed television route for the 2026 men’s and women’s tournaments.
image_alt: Rush Live and Louder CPL cricket broadcast announcement
key_points: Coverage includes the men’s CPL from 7 August and the women’s competition.
Channel numbers and subscription packages depend on the local provider.

sections.heading: What Rush Live & Louder will carry
paragraphs: CPL and Rush Sports launched Rush Live & Louder as a dedicated Caribbean cricket channel. The service is scheduled to show the 2026 men’s and women’s CPL, alongside highlights, archive matches and other cricket programming.
The men’s season begins on 7 August. Viewers should confirm the exact match and channel number with their television provider before the opening fixture.

sections.heading: How viewers can access it
paragraphs: Rush describes the channel as available through major cable and television networks across the Caribbean. Access can still vary by island, provider and package.
A regional rights announcement does not guarantee that every household receives the same channel tier. Provider listings remain the practical check before paying or changing a plan.

sections.heading: Coverage outside the Caribbean
paragraphs: Willow lists the 2026 tournament for viewers in the United States and Canada. Other territories remain pending until a current broadcaster or CPL announcement confirms a 2026 route.
Previous-season rights lists should not be treated as current. The Watch Live guide separates confirmed markets from those still awaiting an announcement.
